name: ProxyCheck
author: Mahmoud Maz
description: Check whether an IP address (or the IPs a domain, FQDN or URL resolves to) is a proxy, VPN, Tor exit node, scraper, compromised or hosting address using proxycheck.io. Also returns a risk score, operator, location and ASN information.

configurationItems.name: key
configurationItems.description: API key for proxycheck.io (optional: without a key the limit is 100 queries per day)

configurationItems.name: max_resolved_ips
configurationItems.description: Maximum number of resolved IPs to look up for domain, FQDN and URL observables
